sections.Profile:
Williams' Touchdown and Kickoff are electro-mechanical pinball machines released in 1967, both designed by Steve Kordek with a football theme. Touchdown, released in November 1967, is a replay version with a production run of 2,253 units. Kickoff, released in December 1967, is the add-a-ball variant with 1,150 units produced.

- Years made: 1967
